R code for a paper tentatively titled “Hidden Attitudes? Reassessing Support for Same-Sex Marriage in Japan through a List Experiment”

# Data Analysis

```{r}
#penalize excessive significant figures
options(digits = 3)

#prevent scientific notation
options(scipen = 10)

#packages used in this analysis
library(tidyverse)
library(list)
library(tableone)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)

#set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(12345)
```

```{r}
#import raw data
data <- read_csv("data/rawdata.csv", locale = locale(encoding = "CP932"),
                 show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#recode variables

#treatment group vs. control group
table(data$cellname)
table(data$cid)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(treat = case_when(
    cid >= 1  & cid <= 10 ~ 1,
    cid >= 11 & cid <= 20 ~ 0))

100*prop.table(table(data$cellname, data$treat), margin = 1)

#direct question
table(data$q10)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(direct = recode(q10,
                         `1` = 1,
                         `2` = 0))

100*prop.table(table(data$q10, data$direct), margin = 1)
```

```{r}
#convert the format
data <- as.data.frame(data)
```

```{r}
#delete satisficers
table(data$q7_5)
100*prop.table(table(data$q7_5))

data <- data %>%
  filter(q7_5 == 2)
```

```{r}
#check covariate balance
vars <- c("q5", "AGE", "q4", "q8")
table1 <- CreateTableOne(
     vars = vars,
     strata = "treat",
     data = data,
     factorVars = c("q5", "q4", "q8"))
print(table1)

#check design effects
ict.test(y = data$q9_1fa, treat = data$treat, J = 4)

#check ceiling and floor effects
table(data$q9_1fa[data$treat == 0])
100*prop.table(table(data$q9_1fa[data$treat == 0]) )

table(data$q9_1fa[data$treat == 1])
100*prop.table(table(data$q9_1fa[data$treat == 1]))
```

```{r}
#calculate list experiment difference in means
diff.in.means.results <- ictreg(q9_1fa ~ 1, data = data, 
                  treat = "treat", J=4, method = "lm")
summary(diff.in.means.results)

#direct question estimate
p <- mean(data$direct, na.rm = TRUE)

#sample size
n <- sum(!is.na(data$direct))

#standard error
se <- sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n)

p
se
```

```{r}
#subgroup analysis
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    gender    = case_when(q5 == 1 ~ "Men", q5 == 2 ~ "Women"),
    age_group = case_when(AGE < 40 ~ "Younger", AGE < 60 ~ "Middle", AGE < 70 ~ "Older"),
    edu       = case_when(q4 <= 4 ~ "LessBA", q4 %in% 5:6 ~ "BAorAbove"),
    political = case_when(q8 <= 3 ~ "Liberal", q8 == 4 ~ "Center", q8 >= 5 ~ "Conservative")
  )

men <- data %>% filter(gender == "Men")
fit_men <- ictreg(q9_1fa ~ 1, data = men, treat = "treat", J = 4, method = "lm")
summary(fit_men)
mean(men$direct, na.rm = TRUE)

women <- data %>% filter(gender == "Women")
fit_women <- ictreg(q9_1fa ~ 1, data = women, treat = "treat", J = 4, method = "lm")
summary(fit_women)
mean(women$direct, na.rm = TRUE)

younger <- data %>% filter(age_group == "Younger")
fit_younger <- ictreg(q9_1fa ~ 1, data = younger, treat = "treat", J = 4, method = "lm")
summary(fit_younger)
mean(younger$direct, na.rm = TRUE)

middle <- data %>% filter(age_group == "Middle")
fit_middle <- ictreg(q9_1fa ~ 1, data = middle, treat = "treat", J = 4, method = "lm")
summary(fit_middle)
mean(middle$direct, na.rm = TRUE)

older <- data %>% filter(age_group == "Older")
fit_older <- ictreg(q9_1fa ~ 1, data = older, treat = "treat", J = 4, method = "lm")
summary(fit_older)
mean(older$direct, na.rm = TRUE)

lessba <- data %>% filter(edu == "LessBA")
fit_lessba <- ictreg(q9_1fa ~ 1, data = lessba, treat = "treat", J = 4, method = "lm")
summary(fit_lessba)
mean(lessba$direct, na.rm = TRUE)

baabove <- data %>% filter(edu == "BAorAbove")
fit_baabove <- ictreg(q9_1fa ~ 1, data = baabove, treat = "treat", J = 4, method = "lm")
summary(fit_baabove)
mean(baabove$direct, na.rm = TRUE)

liberal <- data %>% filter(political == "Liberal")
fit_liberal <- ictreg(q9_1fa ~ 1, data = liberal, treat = "treat", J = 4, method = "lm")
summary(fit_liberal)
mean(liberal$direct, na.rm = TRUE)

center <- data %>% filter(political == "Center")
fit_center <- ictreg(q9_1fa ~ 1, data = center, treat = "treat", J = 4, method = "lm")
summary(fit_center)
mean(center$direct, na.rm = TRUE)

conservative <- data %>% filter(political == "Conservative")
fit_conservative <- ictreg(q9_1fa ~ 1, data = conservative, treat = "treat", J = 4, method = "lm")
summary(fit_conservative)
mean(conservative$direct, na.rm = TRUE)

#put together the results
list_results <- tibble(
  group = c("Overall", "Men", "Women", "Younger", "Middle", "Older",
            "LessBA", "BAorAbove", "Liberal", "Center", "Conservative"),
  list_est = c(diff.in.means.results$par.treat, fit_men$par.treat, fit_women$par.treat,
               fit_younger$par.treat, fit_middle$par.treat, fit_older$par.treat,
               fit_lessba$par.treat, fit_baabove$par.treat,
               fit_liberal$par.treat, fit_center$par.treat, fit_conservative$par.treat),
  list_se = c(diff.in.means.results$se.treat, fit_men$se.treat, fit_women$se.treat,
              fit_younger$se.treat, fit_middle$se.treat, fit_older$se.treat,
              fit_lessba$se.treat, fit_baabove$se.treat,
              fit_liberal$se.treat, fit_center$se.treat, fit_conservative$se.treat)
)

#get the results of the direct question
direct_overall <- data %>%
  filter(treat == 0) %>%
  summarise(group = "Overall", direct_est = mean(direct, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = sum(!is.na(direct)))

direct_gender <- data %>%
  filter(treat == 0, !is.na(gender)) %>%
  group_by(group = gender) %>%
  summarise(direct_est = mean(direct, na.rm = TRUE), n = sum(!is.na(direct)))

direct_age <- data %>%
  filter(treat == 0, !is.na(age_group)) %>%
  group_by(group = age_group) %>%
  summarise(direct_est = mean(direct, na.rm = TRUE), n = sum(!is.na(direct)))

direct_edu <- data %>%
  filter(treat == 0, !is.na(edu)) %>%
  group_by(group = edu) %>%
  summarise(direct_est = mean(direct, na.rm = TRUE), n = sum(!is.na(direct)))

direct_pol <- data %>%
  filter(treat == 0, !is.na(political)) %>%
  group_by(group = political) %>%
  summarise(direct_est = mean(direct, na.rm = TRUE), n = sum(!is.na(direct)))

direct_results <- bind_rows(direct_overall, direct_gender, direct_age,
                            direct_edu, direct_pol) %>%
  mutate(direct_se = sqrt(direct_est * (1 - direct_est) / n))
```

```{r}
#plot the results

#Code for this figure was developed with assistance from Claude (Anthropic); the underlying analysis and all reported estimates are from the authors' own statistical models

#bootstrap SE for the difference (list - direct)
boot_diff <- function(d, B = 5000) {
  d1 <- d[d$treat == 1, ]
  d0 <- d[d$treat == 0, ]
  replicate(B, {
    b1 <- d1[sample(nrow(d1), replace = TRUE), ]
    b0 <- d0[sample(nrow(d0), replace = TRUE), ]
    (mean(b1$q9_1fa) - mean(b0$q9_1fa)) - mean(b0$direct, na.rm = TRUE)
  })
}

boot_se <- function(d) sd(boot_diff(d))

boot_results <- tibble(
  group = c("Overall", "Men", "Women", "Younger", "Middle", "Older",
            "LessBA", "BAorAbove", "Liberal", "Center", "Conservative"),
  diff_se_boot = c(boot_se(data), boot_se(men), boot_se(women),
                   boot_se(younger), boot_se(middle), boot_se(older),
                   boot_se(lessba), boot_se(baabove),
                   boot_se(liberal), boot_se(center), boot_se(conservative))
)

results <- list_results %>%
  left_join(direct_results, by = "group") %>%
  left_join(boot_results, by = "group") %>%
  mutate(
    panel = case_when(group == "Overall" ~ "Overall",
                      group %in% c("Men", "Women") ~ "Gender",
                      group %in% c("Younger", "Middle", "Older") ~ "Age",
                      group %in% c("LessBA", "BAorAbove") ~ "Education",
                      TRUE ~ "Ideology"),

    # 95% CIs (in percent)
    list_lo   = (list_est - 1.96 * list_se) * 100,
    list_hi   = (list_est + 1.96 * list_se) * 100,
    direct_lo = (direct_est - 1.96 * direct_se) * 100,
    direct_hi = (direct_est + 1.96 * direct_se) * 100,

    
    
    # difference: list - direct (percentage points)
    diff    = (list_est - direct_est) * 100,
    diff_se = diff_se_boot * 100,
    diff_lo = diff - 1.96 * diff_se,
    diff_hi = diff + 1.96 * diff_se,
    diff_label = sprintf("%.1f", diff),

    # order and labels for the figure
    panel = factor(panel, levels = c("Overall", "Gender", "Age", "Education", "Ideology")),
    group = factor(group,
                   levels = rev(c("Overall", "Men", "Women", "Younger", "Middle", "Older",
                                  "LessBA", "BAorAbove", "Liberal", "Center", "Conservative")),
                   labels = rev(c("Overall", "Men", "Women",
                                  "Younger (20-39)", "Middle (40-59)", "Older (60-69)",
                                  "Less than BA", "BA or above",
                                  "Liberal", "Center", "Conservative")))
  )

print(results, width = Inf)   # check the numbers before plotting

# long format for the left panel
left <- bind_rows(
  results %>% transmute(panel, group, method = "Direct question",
                        est = direct_est * 100, lo = direct_lo, hi = direct_hi),
  results %>% transmute(panel, group, method = "List experiment",
                        est = list_est * 100, lo = list_lo, hi = list_hi)
) %>%
  mutate(label  = sprintf("%.1f%%", est),
         method = factor(method, levels = c("List experiment", "Direct question")))

# left panel: direct vs. list
p_left <- ggplot(left, aes(x = est, y = group, shape = method)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), orientation = "y",
                width = 0.15, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 2.5, stroke = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(x = hi, label = label),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), hjust = -0.15, size = 3) +
scale_shape_manual(values = c("Direct question" = 16, "List experiment" = 1),
                   breaks = c("Direct question", "List experiment")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 105),
                     breaks = c(0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100),
                     labels = c("0%", "20%", "40%", "60%", "80%", "100%"),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  labs(x = "Estimated support (%)", y = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, size = 11),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),   # 横線を消す
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# right panel: difference (list - direct)
p_right <- ggplot(results, aes(x = diff, y = group)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = diff_lo, xmax = diff_hi), orientation = "y",
                width = 0.15) +
  geom_point(shape = 15, size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(aes(x = diff_hi, label = diff_label), hjust = -0.15, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-35, 35), breaks = seq(-30, 30, 10)) +
  facet_grid(panel ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Difference: list - direct (pp)", y = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),   # 横線を消す
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# combine
figure1 <- p_left + p_right +
  plot_layout(widths = c(2.2, 1), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Figure 1. Support for same-sex marriage in Japan:\nDirect question vs. list experiment",
    caption = "Note. Error bars indicate 95% confidence intervals.",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 12),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "italic"),  # 左揃え
      plot.caption.position = "plot"                            # 図の左端基準
    )
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

figure1

ggsave("figure/figure1.png", figure1, width = 11, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```
